title: fix(models): list standalone models with the catalog owner's plugin registry
body:
Prerequisite for #166311.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: without a running Gateway, `openclaw models list --refresh` lists every configured `anthropic/*` model that runs through Claude CLI as unavailable, even when Claude Code is logged in. Only the default row is left (unavailable); the usable models show up only as their `claude-cli/*` copies.

## User Impact

After `openclaw onboard --auth-choice anthropic-cli`, `openclaw models list --refresh` without a Gateway now lists the configured Claude models as available on Claude CLI, the same as the Gateway picker. Gateway output doesn't change.

## Why This Change Was Made

A prepared model-catalog owner carries its own plugin registry, and that registry can differ from the process's active one. The standalone `openclaw models list` and the embedded TUI use a temporary owner, and Gateway owners belong to a workspace generation. `prepareModelsListResult` already passes `owner.pluginRegistry` to some calls, but CLI backend bindings, Claude CLI auth evaluation and runtime choices still read the ambient registry (for example `listCliRuntimeModelBackendBindings()` in `model-catalog-decisions.ts`). The standalone command's active registry has no CLI backends. So `anthropic/*` rows pinned to `claude-cli` fail auth, and the default view drops 9 of the 10.

`prepareModelsListResult` now resolves the owner first (`resolveModelsListOwner`), then runs preparation inside `withPluginRuntimeRegistryScope(owner.pluginRegistry, …)`, the helper the row projection already uses for worker placement. Reads stay pure projections of the prepared facts and never enter a plugin scope, keeping #162326's published-read invariant (`models.prepared.test.ts`); the existing per-row worker-placement scope is kept as is. The one read-time plugin fact, the CLI backend bindings behind picker runtime choices, is now resolved once from the decisions owner's `pluginRegistry` in `createModelCatalogDecisions` instead of from the ambient registry on every read. The scoped preparation covers every `prepareModelsListResult` caller: the Gateway handler, `chat.metadata`, the standalone CLI, the TUI and the preloaded projector. Not covered and unchanged: uncached runtime-choice auth evaluations (`model-auth-availability.ts`) and `chat-metadata-session-projection.ts` projecting its preloaded catalog before preparation still read the ambient registry; the tests here don't claim those paths. Owner resolution moved unchanged into `models-list-result.owner.ts`, because `models-list-result.ts` is at the repository line cap.

One existing runtime-choices case changed its fixture: `picker-fixture` + generic harness `picker-native` → `picker-fixture` + `codex`. The old case only came out `unsupported-runtime` because the registered fixture harness was invisible to ambient-registry lookups. A registered generic harness is compatible with any provider, while `codex` explicitly rejects non-OpenAI providers (`session-runtime-compat.ts`), so the case still asserts "registered harness, incompatible provider → `unsupported-runtime`".

#166311 (one picker row per Claude CLI model) depends on this. Its twin collapse has to read CLI backends from the same registry as availability.

## Evidence

Live proof on the exact head `c9796892845`, rerun after the design changed (pure reads; decisions resolve CLI backend bindings from the owner registry). Setup is unchanged: `HOME`, state and config under /tmp, no Anthropic API key, config from the real `openclaw onboard --non-interactive --auth-choice anthropic-cli`, and Claude Code logged in through a copied credentials file in an isolated `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. Both checkouts were built with `pnpm build`, and runs alternated main/head one after the other.

Standalone `openclaw models list --refresh --json`, no Gateway running (stderr: "Gateway is not running. Refreshing the local model catalog."):

| | origin/main (87757564646) | this branch (c9796892845) |
|---|---|---|
| `anthropic/*` | 10 rows, all `available: false` | 10 rows, all `available: true` |
| `claude-cli/*` | 11 rows, all available | 11 rows, all available |

5 of 5 runs on each side matched its column. All three `claude auth status` probes finished in 0.15-0.44 s with exit 0 in every run, so no row depended on the probe timeout described below. (Current main now lists all 10 configured `anthropic/*` rows, where the earlier 2c620bbfe84 showed only the default row. All 10 are still unavailable.)

Isolated Gateway on c9796892845 (`openclaw gateway run`, same state), `gateway call models.list`: `view: "configured"` and `view: "default"`, 3 calls each. Every call returned 10 `anthropic/*` rows, all `available: true` with `agentRuntime.id: "claude-cli"`, plus 11 `claude-cli/*` rows. The Gateway and standalone paths agree.

Earlier rounds on 2c620bbfe84 vs this change (before the pure-read redesign) matched too: 14 runs on origin/main and 5 on the branch, plus 23 inside #166311.

Tests, both through the real consumer:
- `list.prepared-catalog.test.ts`: the real `openclaw models list` command, with a standalone owner whose registry alone has the Claude CLI backend. On origin/main it fails with `anthropic/claude-opus-5` `available: false`; here it passes.
- `models-list-result.plugin-runtime.test.ts`: a prepared owner reached through `prepareModelsListResult`, as the Gateway and `chat.metadata` reach it, with an empty active registry. It fails on origin/main and also fails when only `buildModelsListResult` is scoped; here it passes.
- `models-list-result.plugin-runtime.test.ts` (runtime choice): a configured `anthropic/claude-opus-5` with `pickerRuntimes: ["openclaw", "claude-cli"]`, owner registry with the Claude CLI backend, empty active registry. Before the decisions fix the `claude-cli` choice reads `available: false`; now `true`.
- `models-list-result.*`, `models*.test.ts` (incl. `models.prepared.test.ts`), `chat-metadata*`, `src/commands/models/list*`, `model-catalog-decisions` and `models.test.ts` passed on this change. `tsgo:core:test` and `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` passed too.

### First run after a rebuild showing only `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 false`

During the work on #166311, one standalone run of the fixed code came back like origin/main's logged-out output: only `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5`, `available: false`, and no `claude-cli/*` rows. That isn't this change, and it isn't a build artifact. It's the existing Claude login probe:
- A standalone list runs `claude auth status --json` three times (`extensions/anthropic/cli-auth-seam.ts`, 3 s timeout). If the second probe times out, it counts as unreadable, so every Claude row is unavailable.
- Delaying exactly that probe to 3.5 s gives the identical output on origin/main, on this branch and on #166311. Delaying the first or third probe changes nothing.
- Observed probe times ranged from 0.14 s to 3.0 s; the slow ones came when several `claude` processes shared one config dir. Once in 23 runs, during a concurrent test run, the slow case happened on its own: that run took 4 s longer and logged only two completed probes.
- "Right after a rebuild" was a coincidence. Every `run-node` call in that session rebuilt because the tree was dirty, and the other rebuild runs were correct.
- On a Gateway, #166305's background recheck corrects a timed-out probe within a minute.

Known and unchanged: the read-only `openclaw models list` (no `--refresh`, no Gateway) reads a cached owner that has no plugin registry. It still shows the single unavailable default row.

## Bounded cost

- One AsyncLocalStorage frame around preparation and one CLI backend listing per decisions owner; none per `read()` (previously the bindings were listed on every runtime-choice read). No I/O, discovery or probing: with start-logging, every standalone list started three `claude auth status` probes on both origin/main and this branch.
- No new state, config, protocol or messages.
- Local test cost, `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1` wall time (Apple Silicon): `src/commands/models/list.prepared-catalog.test.ts` 33.5 s (17 tests, vitest 28.3 s) and `src/gateway/server-methods/models-list-result.runtime-choices.test.ts` 30.2 s (9 tests, vitest 26.9 s), both measured on 355ced4cfc5 and unchanged since; `src/gateway/server-methods/models-list-result.plugin-runtime.test.ts` 40.5 s (11 tests, vitest 32.8 s) on c9796892845. Transform dominates (75-80%); test bodies are 12-17%.
- CI test cost, run [37555824195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37555824195) on c9796892845, summed per-test times per file: `list.prepared-catalog` 2.6 s (17 tests, shard `agentic-commands-models`), `models-list-result.runtime-choices` 2.1 s (9 tests, `agentic-gateway-methods-hosted-5`), `models-list-result.plugin-runtime` 2.9 s (11 tests, `agentic-gateway-methods-hosted-6`). Shared-shard totals, not per-file: those vitest batches took 16.9 s (8 files), 78.0 s (7 files) and 58.6 s (9 files). Several other shards in that run were cancelled by fail-fast after an unrelated red (see CI below), so no whole-run total is available.

LOC vs origin/main: +408/-131 total; 199 production lines are owner resolution moved verbatim into `models-list-result.owner.ts`; tests +153/-2.



## CI

On c9796892845, the only red test is `src/gateway/server.chat.gateway-server-chat-b.test.ts` > "chat.history advances past a replay boundary that cannot fit all projected siblings" (line 5681); the other failed jobs were cancelled by fail-fast. It fails 3/3 on clean origin/main 6c352f46196 and passes 3/3 on this branch locally, so it's unrelated. The earlier 4eaa9daa5b8 red, `src/flows/doctor-health.plugin-load.test.ts` (3 ENOSPC cases), also fails on clean origin/main 6c352f46196.
